why: Montgomery and Sauermann (arXiv:2508.05601, Aug 2025) prove asymptotically-tight results improving the number of transversal bases that can be packed/covered, narrowing the gap toward the full n bases the conjecture asks for; this is progress on the conjecture's own quantitative bound, not a different problem.

found.title: Asymptotically-tight packing and covering with transversal bases in Rota's basis conjecture
found.note: Preprint by Montgomery and Sauermann improving quantitative bounds toward the conjecture; not read.
